messages:
Mia Chen: Kicking off an async sync for Tardis private rollout. Quick summary: staging showed intermittent egress failures to our external image registry when behind customer's proxy. Need to pin owners & next steps.

Sanjay Rao: Saw the flake too — reproduces ~1/10 requests to quay.io timing out. Stack traces point at TLS handshake stalls from our egress NAT.

Jamie Ortega: @Alex (netops) can you confirm if the customer's outbound proxy is applying connection rate limits? We hit a similar pattern last quarter.

Alex (netops): Will check with their infra team now. Quick note: their side uses a proxy appliance that does connection pooling but has a 60s idle timeout we haven't tuned for long-lived keepalives.

Priya Patel: Customer (Tardis Health) confirmed they rolled a proxy upgrade yesterday — they think only UI traffic was affected but will share firewall logs.

Mia Chen: Thanks. Action items I see: 1) Alex to validate proxy timeouts and NAT session behavior; 2) Eng-runtime to add a retry/backoff tweak for image pulls as short term; 3) Devex to add an egress smoke for private rollouts.

Sanjay Rao: For (2) I opened a tiny PR that adds a 3-attempt backoff for docker pulls in the image-syncer: https://github.com/redwood-inference/image-syncer/pull/312 — needs review + CI sign-off.

Jamie Ortega: Reviewing PR now. Quick code note: prefer exponential backoff with jitter to avoid thundering herd against proxy. Also add a small metric for pull_attempts.count.

Mia Chen: Good call. @DeployBot can you add a check to run the egress smoke (curl test) after we promote the canary?

DeployBot: scheduled job created: eng-platform/private-tardis-egress-smoke on promotion -> runs curl check to quay.io from each canary host.

Alex (netops): Triage update: customer's proxy team says idle timeout is 45s and max concurrent sessions per source IP is 200. They can bump idle to 300s for our canary CIDR during the cutover window.

Tara Nguyen: If they can bump the idle timeout, we should also push a config to our image-syncer to prefer range requests and resume instead of restarting full downloads. That reduces open connections.

Sanjay Rao: I'll add range/resume support to the syncer; target patch by EOD. Jamie — can you pair on tests?

Jamie Ortega: Yup, will pair. Also adding unit tests for jitter/backoff and a quick integ test that simulates proxy timeouts.

Priya Patel: Customer confirmed they will schedule the proxy parameter change at 03:00 UTC tomorrow and will notify 30m prior.

Mia Chen: Plan for rollout window: 02:30 UTC — dry run promoting a single canary with DeployBot smoke; 03:00 UTC — customer bumps timeout; 03:30 UTC — expand to 3 canaries. If egress error rate > 1% revert.

Alex (netops): I will be on-call for the window and watching NAT session counts. I will also request a temporary route to drain unused sessions if needed.

Jamie Ortega: PR #312 updated with exponential backoff + jitter and a feature flag: image_syncer.retry_policy=canary_backoff. CI green locally, pushing for review.

Sanjay Rao: Merging once Jamie approves. Tagging @Tara Nguyen for image-syncer release notes and rollback steps.

Tara Nguyen: Got it — will draft release note and rollback: revert image-syncer tag to v1.8.2 and disable feature flag.

Mia Chen: Final checklist before window: - Alex confirm proxy bump is scheduled (yes) - PR merged & canary image pushed (Sanjay/Jamie) - DeployBot job ready (DeployBot done) - Customer to notify 30m prior (Priya confirmed)

Alex (netops): Confirmed. I will post a short runbook message in #incidents 10m before the bump.

Priya Patel: I'll relay runbook steps to the customer's SRE. They asked if we can provide a curl snippet to validate from their side.

Mia Chen: Paste this for them:

curl -v --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 --retry-connrefused https://quay.io/repository/redwood/image-manifest -o /dev/null

Mia Chen: Anything else? Otherwise we'll execute the plan tomorrow. :thumbsup:

Alex (netops): All set from my side.

Jamie Ortega: Ready to review and merge after a quick second look.

Sanjay Rao: Thanks team — I'll post a short postmortem if anything goes sideways.

DeployBot: canary promotion triggered at 02:34 UTC (simulated for dry run). Logs: 2/50 pulls retried and succeeded, egress errors 0.8% during 02:34-02:40 UTC.
